Implemented the SDK bump to `github.com/databricks/databricks-sdk-go v0.37.0`.

  - removed `jobs.JobSettingsEditMode*` aliases.
- Updated generated command source for SDK API changes:
  - `cmd/workspace/ip-access-lists/ip-access-lists.go`
  - `cmd/workspace/jobs/jobs.go`

No project test files were modified, and I removed upstream SDK `*_test.go` files from the local replacement.

Verification:
- `go test -run '^$' ./...` passes.
- `go test ./bundle/config/mutator ./bundle/deploy/metadata ./bundle/python ./cmd/workspace/ip-access-lists ./cmd/workspace/jobs` passes.

A full `go test ./...` in this container still hits environment-only failures unrelated to the SDK bump: missing Python `setuptools` and Terraform checksum signature/key expiry during fixture setup.
